MOD_CONST = 10**9 + 7

def matrix_multiply(A, B, K):
    result = [[0]*(K+1) for _ in range(K+1)]
    for i in range(K+1):
        for j in range(K+1):
            for k in range(K+1):
                result[i][j] = (result[i][j] + A[i][k] * B[k][j]) % MOD_CONST
    return result

N, K = map(int, input().split())
digits = []
while N:
    digits.append(N % K)
    N //=K

# Initialize matrices A[0][i]
A = [[[[0]*(K+1) for _ in range(30)] for _ in range(65)] for _ in range(30)]
P = [[[[0]*(K+1) for _ in range(30)] for _ in range(65)] for _ in range(30)]
S = [[[[0]*(K+1) for _ in range(30)] for _ in range(65)] for _ in range(30)]
res = [[0]*(K+1) for _ in range(K+1)]

# Build initial matrices A[0][i]
for i in range(K):
    for j in range(K+1):
        A[0][i][0][j] = 0
    for j in range(K+1):
        A[0][i][0][j] = 0
        A[0][i][j][j] = 1
        A[0][i][i][j] = 1

# Build matrices P and S
for i in range(1, len(digits)):
    # P[i-1][j]
    for j in range(K):
        P[i-1][0][j] = A[0][i-1][0][j]
    for j in range(1, K):
        P[i-1][j] = matrix_multiply(P[i-1][j-1], A[0][i-1][j], K)
    # S[i-1][j]
    for j in range(K-1, -1, -1):
        S[i-1][j] = matrix_multiply(A[0][i-1][j], S[i-1][j+1], K) if j < K-1 else A[0][i-1][j]
    # A[i][j]
    for j in range(K):
        A[i][j] = S[i-1][j]
        if j > 0:
            A[i][j] = matrix_multiply(A[i][j], P[i-1][j-1], K)

# Initialize result matrix res
for i in range(K+1):
    res[i][i] = 1

index = 0
for i in range(len(digits)-1, -1, -1):
    for j in range(digits[i]):
        res = matrix_multiply(res, A[i][index], K)
        index = (index + 1) % K

total_value = 0
for i in range(K+1):
    total_value = (total_value + res[i][K]) % MOD_CONST

print(total_value)
